full_judgment:
Mr. Mohammad Gholam Rabbani, J: Respondent No 1 Khetra Mohan Bawali filed Miscellaneous Case No. 40 of 1982 In the Court of District Judge, Faridpur, for obtaining probate of a Will dated 27.12.67 alleged to have been executed by Gopal Chandra Biswas since deceased. Copal Chandra Biswas died leaving four Sons Kalipada, Haripada, Paresh and Sures)). 

 2. Appellants Abdul Hye and Abdul Biswas filed an application for adding them as parties In the said miscellaneous ,case for probate alleging that said four sons of Copal Chandra sold a portion of the land under Will to Abdur Rahman by a registered deed of sale dated 9.4.77; that thereafter appellant No. '1 purchased the same from said Abdur Rahman by a registered deed of sale dated 18.2.78, that Suresh Chandra sold some land under Will to the appellant No. 1, by a registered deed of sale dated 5.7.77, that again four sons of Copal Chandra sold some portion of the land under Will by another deed dated .9/4/77 to Sk. Jaher which was again purchased by the appellant No. 1 on 28.1.78, that lastly said Suresh sold, some land under Will to appellant NO. 2 by a deed of sale dated 31.3.77, that, the appellants had been owning and possessing their purchased land accordingly and that the Will was forged one. 

 5. Learned District Judge, it appears, passed the impugned order hastely and without applying his judicial mind. Sons of testator were necessary parties in the miscellaneous Case for probate. There is no doubt about it. Thereafter, the appellants who claimed interest through the sons of the testator obviously were necessary parties in the probate proceeding. 

 6. The appeal is, therefore, allowed. Impugned order dated 23.7.84 passed by the learned District Judge in Probate Miscellaneous Case No. 40 of 1982 is set aside and the application under Order 1, Rule 1"), C;13.0 filed by Abdul Hye and Abdul Mani Biswas is allowed and they are added as opposite parties in the said miscellaneous case. A further proceeding, of the Probate Miscellaneous Case No. 40 of 1982 passed at the time of admission of the appeal is hereby vacated.
